summary: BJ's Restaurants filed an 8-K after appointing Christopher W. Brandt and James D. White as independent directors, effective September 3, 2026, expanding the board from eight to ten under Article III, Section 2 of the bylaws. Brandt joins Governance and Nominating; White joins Compensation. No arrangement with any other person prompted the appointments, and compensation follows the non-employee director terms disclosed June 23, 2026. A September 9 press release announced the changes. This is a routine board-composition event, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors or activist context are cited. Watch for any subsequent 13D activity.
